title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：wedding　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wedding 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the grandmother ① held the wedding that no child in the courtyard would have counted, and he said the holding was the whole of the year. The ② wedding, meaning the marriage itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a wedding, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ wedding in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ wedding at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wedding, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the grandmother said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wedding was the whole of the matter, meaning the joy and not the marriage. The ⑥ wedding, meaning the joy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; wedding, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a marriage and a joy. He said the joy is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ wedding had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ wedding of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of counting; wedding, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wedding I remember is the marriage counted in the diary, which closed in 1967 and is still counted as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ wedding, my mother said in 1969, is the only marriage that improves by being counted; every wedding, she said, is a joy that has agreed to look like a marriage. She said the joy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 婚礼（指院子里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 婚礼（指那场婚礼本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the wedding 办这一场婚礼
D. n. 婚礼（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 婚礼之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的婚礼之事）
F. n. 婚礼（指日记里写到、被清点的那一场）
G. n. 婚礼、喜庆（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 喜庆（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the wedding that no child in the courtyard would have counted
The wedding, meaning the marriage itself and not the lamp
the wedding at the far window
the wedding was the whole of the matter
the wedding had become a line in a diary
The wedding of the whole thing
A wedding, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: hold the wedding 意为“办这一场婚礼”，1960 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯清点的一场婚礼做了一遍。
wedding 意为“婚礼”，指那场婚礼本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
wedding 意为“婚礼”，指院子里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
wedding 意为“婚礼”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wedding 意为“婚礼、喜庆”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场喜庆就是那件事的全部。
wedding 意为“喜庆”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场婚礼，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wedding 意为“婚礼”，指日记里写到、被清点的那一场，到 1965 年这一场成了日记里的一行。
wedding 意为“婚礼之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的婚礼之事是一处院子和三个年头的清点。
wedding 意为“婚礼”，我记得的是日记里清点过的那一场，1967 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一场。
wedding 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，婚礼是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的婚礼。

items: 1960 年那位祖母办了院子里没有一位孩子肯清点的一场婚礼，他说这一遍才是那个年头的全部。（hold the wedding）
那场婚礼，指的是那场婚礼本身而不是小小的灯，经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。（wedding）
那处院子里每一场婚礼旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。（wedding）
最远那扇窗边那场婚礼，指的是他们留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（wedding）
叔叔说这场喜庆就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那场婚礼。（wedding）
1969 年母亲说，婚礼是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的婚礼。（wedding）
answers: In 1960 the grandmother held the wedding that no child in the courtyard would have counted, and he said the holding was the whole of the year.
The wedding, meaning the marriage itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book.
Every wedding in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it.
The wedding at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the wedding was the whole of the matter, meaning the joy and not the marriage.
A wedding, my mother said in 1969, is the only marriage that improves by being counted.
